title: Oman GDELT event spike leads Brent lower
hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Oman GDELT event count 20d z-score > 1.5 signals de-escalation diplomacy and leads Brent lower by 3 days (-); trade short BZ=F 5d [gdelt.omn.events -> finance.BZ=F.log_return]
message: Not supported: Oman events vs Brent r=+0.14 (n=391, perm p=0.08), opposite sign to hypothesis; short rule hit rate 33%, sharpe -2.4; actionability 1.83

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.omn.events rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short BZ=F next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 2 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Oman GDELT event count 20d z-score > 1.5 marks Gulf tension (not diplomacy) and leads Brent higher by 2 days (+); trade long BZ=F 3d [gdelt.omn.events -> finance.BZ=F.log_return] (parent: R2-0006)
